as_of is the latest goods-received date covered (2026-11-13), not necessarily calendar today.

this_month average unit prices are quantity-weighted from per-day command-upload lines through 2026-11-13. last_month uses a full calendar-month Purchase Summary Item Wise when one exists; otherwise the days actually on file, with gaps listed in coverage.
above_average lists items flagged more than 10% above the own-city period average in the last 7 days.
